description.value: Shamrock Storehouse is an Irish pub chain founded in 2024 by William and Laura Donnellan, immigrants from Co. Galway, Ireland, who built the brand around authentic Irish hospitality. The Granville location at 678 Nelson St. is one of three active Vancouver spots, offering live music, hearty Irish food, and properly poured Guinness in a cozy neighbourhood atmosphere. A fourth Stadium District location is listed as coming soon, signalling the brand's rapid local expansion.
